text:
ivy_fin: FYI Skyloom Systems (acct SK-0812) overdue: three invoices totaling $54,900, oldest 61 days. Collections vendor reports client says their treasury closed ACH and wants to wire (SWIFT) from a new treasury bank. Theyre disputing a $3,400 usage charge on INV-20240903 and are hinting at counsel if we push. @nova_support @rachel_sales can we triage?

billing-bot: System note: INV-20240715 ($18,700), INV-20240810 ($19,500), INV-20240903 ($16,700 with disputed line $3,400). Last payment: $0 in 2024. Collections vendor: Eastfold Outreach started 2024-10-02.

sam_collections: Calls mostly unanswered. Recommend short hold while finance engages; need a firm date or we resume dunning. They mentioned legal representation.

nova_support: I can permit a one-hour portal unlock for wire instruction upload and payment initiation after bank docs verified. Workflow: open ticket, run KYC/fraud checks, then run `/allow-wire-upload --acct=SK-0812 --window=60m --by=nova_support`. Uploads must go to secure intake: https://vault.redwood/payments-upload (no channel DMs). Fraud team must sign off on SWIFT origin.

rachel_sales: I'm prepared to offer an escrow option: client wires undisputed amount into our escrow agent and we hold disputed $3,400 pending meter reconciliation. Alternatively 10% settlement if they pay in full within 5 business days. Will lead communications if finance approves.

ivy_fin: Finance policy: provisional credits up to $2,500 allowed; above needs CFO sign-off. We can escrow disputed amount in AR hold (tag MR-AR-ESCROW). Wires require treasury ops verification.

oliver_cfo: Approve the following conditional steps: 1) provisional escrow of $3,400 pending technical reconciliation for up to 14 days (tag "ESCROW_3400_OLIVER_2024-10-03"); 2) allow one-hour wire-upload window after KYC + bank-letter + correspondent bank confirmation; 3) pause third-party collections for 7 days (resume 2024-10-10) unless client misses commitment. No write-offs without CFO sign-off. Collections: stand down until 2024-10-10 COB.

nova_support: Creating ticket SB-103142 and will collect bank letter + SWIFT confirmation and run fraud checks. Will attach fraud logs and wait for treasury sign-off before enabling `/allow-wire-upload`.

rachel_sales: I'll send the escrow + quick-settlement email and ask them to upload docs. CC collections & finance. If they accept 10% settlement, include payment instructions for the wire.

sam_collections: Pausing outreach until 2024-10-10 COB. If no signed ack/payment, we'll resume escalation on 2024-10-11.

ivy_fin: I'll prepare the escrow journal entry and AR note. Once SB-103142 has docs, I'll post the GL provisional entry MR-AR-ESCROW and confirm. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
